# v2.0-beta.1 (macOS 26 Tahoe): native Wi-Fi, AWDL work in progress

**Wi-Fi kexts for the MediaTek MT7925 (PCI `14c3:7925`) on macOS 26 Tahoe.** Pre-release. For macOS 15 use `v1.1`.
Bluetooth for Tahoe is a separate release: `bt-v1.1`.

> ## Warning: vibe-coded, one-laptop project
> Almost all of this code was written by an AI (Claude) and tested on **one** ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 **GA403WM** on
> macOS 26.7.2 (`25G332`, Darwin 25.6). The kexts run in the macOS kernel and can panic or hang the machine. Nobody has
> audited any of it. No warranty. Back up first and keep another way online (USB Ethernet or tethering).

## What this release is

- Source: branch `dev/awdl`, 132 commits ahead of `main` (`50570a3`, 2026-11-02). `main` was not moved.
- The code is what runs on the test machine since the boots of 2026-11-25 19:46 and 20:42:
  core `itlmt7925` from `a21d94d`, native front end `itlmt7925Native` from `dfe8d61`.
- Both kexts report bundle version 0.1.0 for every build. The UUID is the only way to tell builds apart.
- No Wi-Fi password is inside the kexts. In native mode you join from the Wi-Fi menu and macOS keeps the key.

## What changed since `v1.1` (2026-10-14)

Status words: **verified** = seen working on the GA403WM, with the date; **test only** = measured in a test or in one
session, not as daily use; **in code** = built and loaded, the specific effect was not checked on its own.

### Tahoe port (already on `main`, never released)

| Item | Status |
|---|---|
| Native front end ported to Tahoe (headers from the `25G241` kernel collection, 5-argument `setLinkState`, beacon header 0x44, IE budget, CoreCapture pipes) | verified 2026-10-16/17 |
| Link-quality event 0x27 (no link drop after 60 s), DFS channels, `getNSS` | verified 2026-10-17: 176.6 / 65.0 Mb/s, joined ch 52 at 160 MHz |
| Cipher-aware keys (WPA/WPA2 mixed, TKIP group) | verified 2026-10-18 |
| AP table 48 to 128 | in code; not confirmed on hardware |

### New on `dev/awdl`

| Item | Status |
|---|---|
| Group-key rekey answered on the link (drops every 30 to 80 s were the AP removing us) | verified 2026-11-04 |
| Two MCU timeouts in a row request a chip reset and a firmware reload | in code since 2026-11-04; why the firmware goes silent is not known |
| M4 waits for TXFREE before the PTK install; a retransmitted M3 is answered | in code |
| Regulatory country from the AP's Country IE (was always `00`) | in code since 2026-11-06 |
| eeprom command as Linux, power tables at join | verified 2026-11-08 cold boot: data TX works, 0.2 % fail; 215 / 205 Mb/s on a strong AP |
| Sniffer width table (a 160 MHz AP hung the firmware) | loaded since 2026-11-09 |
| RSSI from the exact Linux RXD layout | loaded since 2026-11-10 |
| Open networks (no RSN) | used on an open network 2026-11-11 |
| Native ABI gate at module start: Apple's class sizes are checked and the load fails on a mismatch; covers the macOS 26 line instead of one build | running since 2026-11-08; checked against `25G332` |
| CCFaultReporter on its own work loop; no `mDNS_KEY` / keepalive offload advertised (sleep took 17.5 s longer) | loaded since 2026-11-08 / 2026-11-05 |
| `ItlWiFi.app` removed (the native front end replaces it) | n/a |

### AWDL / AirDrop (only with `itlmt_awdl=1`): not usable, do not enable for daily use

| Item | Status |
|---|---|
| `awdl0` data path, TCP over AWDL | test only, 2026-11-04 |
| First completed AirDrop transfer, Mac to Mac | test only, once, 2026-11-11 |
| On-channel AWDL data between windows | AirDrop to a nearby MacBook, 2026-11-23 |
| `MT_TXD3_BCM` on group frames, run-time A/B switch `itl_awdlbcm` | A/B run 2026-11-25: with `itl_awdlbcm=2` the peer comes back within a second, then flickers. The nearby devices follow another AWDL master; our tree does not merge with theirs. Open |
| Unicast `awdl0` activity reported to Apple's peer manager (boot-arg `itlmt_awdl_act=0` turns it off) | loaded since 2026-11-25; its effect on AirDrop is not measured yet |

Details: `docs/ROADMAP-AWDL.md` §10.88 to §10.95.

## Known issues

- AirDrop / AWDL is not usable (see above).
- A join that goes silent 4 s after link-up: cause not known (ROADMAP "Known bugs").
- Some APs fail the 4-way handshake at speed level 6 and pass at level 3: cause not known; the ladder steps down.
- Upload is slower than download. A-MSDU receive is off on purpose.
- **Sleep / wake in native mode is not verified.**
- WPA3 / SAE, 802.1X and 6 GHz are not implemented.
- Run on `25G332` and `25G241` only. On another macOS 26 build the ABI gate should make the native kext refuse to load
  rather than panic; that path has not been exercised.
- Legacy mode (Ethernet-style, password in the kext) is not tested on Tahoe.

## Install

[docs/GUIDE.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos/blob/dev/awdl/docs/GUIDE.md) ·
[Tiếng Việt](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos/blob/dev/awdl/docs/GUIDE.vi.md).
In `Kernel → Add`: `itlmt7925.kext` first, then `itlmt7925Native.kext` with `MinKernel 25.0.0`. Boot-args:
`itlmt_native=1 itlmt_native_if=1 itlmt_native_dp=1 itlmt_fast=6`.

## Roadmap

1. AWDL: get onto the timeline of the master the nearby peers follow; then phase 6 hardening and the merge into `main`.
2. Sleep / wake in native mode.
3. WPA3 / SAE, upload speed, the A-MSDU root cause.
4. Reports from other MT7925 machines (none so far).

## Assets

The two zips were built on 2026-11-25 from this tag's source with `bash scripts/build.sh itlmt7925 itlmt7925Native`, then
`strip -S` (removes the debug symbol entries, which carry local build paths) and `ditto -c -k --keepParent`.

**They are not the files from the test machine's EFI.** Every loaded section of each binary (`__TEXT` and `__DATA`:
code, constants, strings, the embedded firmware) is byte-identical to the kext that ran (core UUID `D2CAADD0`, native
UUID `149441A4`); only the symbol table differs, so the UUIDs differ. The `Info.plist` files are byte-identical to the
ones that ran. The Wi-Fi credential fields (`itl_ssid*`, `itl_psk*`) are empty.
